description: This file defines an enumeration GatewayConnectChallengeSupport with static functions to process nonce data and wait for a nonce asynchronously, utilizing protocols for error handling and timing control.

methods.name: nonce(from payload: [String: OpenClawProtocol.AnyCodable]?) -> String?
methods.description: Extracts and trims the nonce string from a payload dictionary if present and non-empty.

methods.name: waitForNonce(timeoutSeconds:onTimeout:receiveNonce:)
methods.description: Asynchronously waits for a nonce by repeatedly calling receiveNonce until a non-nil value is returned or a timeout occurs.
